gate.per_env_note: both test environments with positive labels (logistics_x_courier_station_0011, logistics_x_courier_station_0041) must each reach 0.60; environments with zero positives are reported as NA and excluded
gate.evaluation_scope: test split scored once per pre-registered arm, hand-frame level, n=24482, positives=462, prevalence=0.018871

arms.A_smooth_reliability: existing p1_reliability fused score (geometry logistic 0.5 + Mahalanobis 0.5) + bidirectional EMA temporal smoothing; alpha selected on validation only
arms.B_nextframe_residual: self-supervised next-frame ridge residual features (6, train-fit only) + per-record robust-normalised 16 geometry features -> logistic regression
arms.C_multitask_raw: DualTCN (T=15/60) on the original 82-d state features + occlusion/near-edge auxiliary heads (direction 3, reproduction baseline)
arms.D_full_v2: DualTCN (T=15/60) on 82-d state features with per-record robust-normalised geometry + 6 residual features, auxiliary heads, then bidirectional EMA smoothing of logits (all three directions combined; primary arm)

selection_rule: D_full_v2 is the primary pre-registered arm; gate is judged on D_full_v2 only. A/B/C are component ablations reported for attribution, never used to pick D post hoc.
notes: per-record robust normalisation uses only unlabelled feature statistics of the same record (offline video available in full) — no label leakage
temperature/Platt calibration fitted on validation only
test is never used for early stopping, alpha selection, or calibration
